venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Friday 8/14** Beat target by 37.3% on a very hot Friday. Summer crowd was chiller than the prior Friday, so the team leaned on downtime to build connections and talk up activations. Mid and opener held the bar until the closers and barback arrived — Jayden's first barback shift went well and he adjusted quickly with support; BOH came out to help the bar throughout the night. Opener left around 9pm and the house stayed fairly quiet, with the DJ setting the vibe. Bar was closed down with Saturday's event in mind. Kitchen sales continue to rise — prep accordingly. 86: Maker's 46, Lalo; low aquavit. Favorite moment: bingo regulars coming in for a birthday. MOD: Mkz/JK, entered by Mya.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Friday 8/14** Big Friday at +49.6% to target. The team joked it was their 'second Friday' after a strong Thursday. Decent early crowd — about $2,500 by 8pm — with the second wave arriving earlier than typical and full swing by 9:30pm. Annie stayed on longer for the later push; by midnight the pace was even keel through the end of the night. The hot weather likely pushed more people into the cool basement. Incident: a guest, Nolan Lamb, became unruly and disrespectful to guests and staff and was escorted out — shout out to security guard Anthony for handling it quickly. Kitchen: Danny did a great job holding down his first Friday night. Low: High Life. Favorite moment: Sara's hustle — she was everywhere, beating BC to the ice run before he could finish it. MOD: KE, KK, DM.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Friday 8/14** Finished 12.6% under target on a night the weather dictated. DC/AM did $1,120 on a busy day — cold brew finished, Carey prepped iced teas. D&C (PM) did $14,602: busy from the start with a small waitlist well before 5pm, then the storms and hail hit, the Garden closed, and everyone moved indoors. The room stayed full, then tapered; the team got off a wait multiple times and kept the bar full. Southwest closed at 10, all openers cut by 10, and an easy slow close as the rain moved out. Garden/6A managed $222 before the rain shut it down. Kitchen had a steady night with no hiccups. Comps $437.75. Favorite moments: Dom's mom in, GDTing a couple getting married in Crested Butte in two weeks, positive table touches, Evan on bar, and Maggie H & friends. MODs: Carey + Evan (AM), Maggie S + Evan (PM).

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Friday 8/14** Finished 15.1% under target but a very well-managed evening. Smooth flow thanks to impeccable door communication and pacing plus bar/management assists on the floor. Strong energy for the first couple of turns on the back of large parties in the center, both reservations and walk-ins, and a smooth close with a few last-minute rounds before last call. Sean crushed it solo on the floor and Kyler was in full octopus mode dual-bartending and backing up. Full most of the night with a two-hour waitlist, and the steadier pace let the team spend 10–15 minutes with guests between seatings. Guests included TikTok comedian Erika Olsen from LA, a 6-top bachelor party, a 9-top family celebrating a 21st, first-time solos including new local Judy and Kyle (bar manager at Artemis), plus Drew from El Camino, Meg from High Life, Koba, and Tanner's crew from Wonderland. Note: two reservations were bookable an hour out (12am and 1am), causing slight waitlist delays. No-shows: Sachin Das (2 at 8pm), Christy Gonzalez (2 at 11:15pm) — charged. Top sellers: Rosalie, Eight Limb Daiquiri, Paper Wasp (three-way tie). Glassware: 2 DOF, 2 Fancy Fizz, 1 coupe. MOD: Kyler / Steves.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Friday 8/14** Landed within $3 of target (99.97%). Opened Standing Room early for Parlor Social Club — 40–45 guests between 6 and 8:30pm — with a mixup on the two-hour allotment and a wonky transition from event back to classic service; SR team handled the shenanigans and future similar events will be scheduled on non-weekend days. The first two hours in Marquee were awfully slow with little action until 9pm. Ariana crushed her host training, efficient on the mic and turning the room quickly. Few large-party reservations, but a lot of large-party walk-ins kept the room full until around 11pm. A hard stop led to closing Standing Room early around midnight with a few groups moved to Marquee; another small pop at 12:30 filled the room for kitchen last call. SR $2,895 (food $402), Marquee $8,957 (food $2,226). Kitchen was busy — lots of oysters and fries, great ticket times, and Saleh remade an oyster for a guest after last call. Event note: Parlor Social Club spent roughly $450–500; the host will note a hard-out next time, as standing guests blocking the aisle made regular service difficult. Comps $275.22. MOD: Gigi/Joe, Chefs Josh/Saleh.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Friday 8/14** Finished 6.2% under target. Marquee bar did $7,672.35, Garden $1,636. Garden had a slower start that picked up with on-and-off foot traffic; on another humid evening the team kept guests hydrated and moved them inside quickly, and a few came off the waitlist to stay in the Garden, keeping flow steady. Strong communication and consistent check-ins on the solo bartender — ice, refills, pre-bussing and general support. Marquee was steady, slow to start, picking up around 7:30pm, dipping around 10:30pm, then another push at 11:45pm that carried through last call. Pacing was smooth with tables turned to move the waitlist. Plenty of hands on the floor including a stage learning the ropes. To tighten: pre-bussing, water service, a few wrong items rung in, and round building/dilution/aeration to be revisited in pre-shift. Bar top stayed full most of the night with ticket times on track. Kitchen had a slow but consistent flow, picking up moderately late. Comps $193.15 (2.1%), voids $124 (1.3%). Maintenance: point well needs attention ASAP (running on mid), and new carb caps needed. MOD: Marcus / Josh.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Friday 8/14** Finished 8.6% under target. Municipal Bar morning did $922 on 20 guests — very quiet but enough hotel patrons to keep the server busy, a few Sun Club orders and one easy tour with a new pre-set that timed out well. Evening did $7,330 on 206 guests: happy hour was quiet, dinner started rolling shortly after 5pm at a steady pace with quick table turns, and the room filled significantly around 8:30 with the kitchen feeling the heat on food tickets the rest of the night. Ran without a host but the team kept sections clean and stayed alert to new guests; four servers held until 9:30. Guests lingered late into closing again, and a group asked to drink on the Mezzanine — signs of busier times ahead. Sun Club $745 — good crowd when Jack came in at 3, thinning after 5; lots of Hugo orders. Hot Eye $1,975 — slow until 9pm when the room filled fast, with busy pops and long lulls, a mix of locals and hotel guests and the usual late service-industry crowd; Eva returned downstairs and handled the volume well. The 'rotten' smell persisted and was masked with a candle. Kitchen: busy night, one steak sent back for temp, otherwise good service. Maintenance: BOH ceiling drips spreading with heavier flow, egg smell in THE, floors and bathrooms in THE. Favorite moment: Chandler wowing in-house Death & Co investors on a birthday trip. MODs: Braden (AM), Justin (PM); Chefs Lex & Drew.
